Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a right pleural effusion and an anomalous vessel draining into the inferior vena cava/right atrium region (characteristic of Scimitar syndrome), which corresponds to the "left second arc protrusion" (likely referring to the prominent right heart border/atrium often mislabeled or describing the vascular anomaly's effect) without generalized cardiomegaly. This congenital vascular anomaly explains the findings better than heart failure or pneumonia.
